concurrency.description: Maximum number of live workers. Serial by default.

schedulerIntervalMs.description: How often queued work is admitted.

reconcileIntervalMs.description: How often live workers are reconciled against the harnesses.

stallAfterMinutes.description: A busy worker with no activity for this long gets an inspection request. Workers are never killed.

stallRealertMinutes.description: At most one stall alert per task per window.

attentionExpiryMinutes.description: Unanswered permission requests and questions expire and are denied; they are never replayed.

digestWindowMs.description: Notifications raised within this many milliseconds of the first one are sent as one digest ("4 ready for review, 1 needs you"). 0 sends on the next outbox pass without waiting.

focusApp.description: Terminal app to bring forward when a notification is clicked: a macOS bundle id (com.mitchellh.ghostty) or a Linux window class (kitty). Detected from tmux by default.

serviceFile.description: OpenCode service registration file; defaults to OpenCode's own discovery path.

workerIdleMinutes.description: Claude Code and Codex worker processes stop after this long idle; their sessions resume on the next instruction.

enabled.description: Offer Claude Code workers (profiles with harness claude).

binary.description: Absolute path of the claude binary; defaults to a lookup on the PATH your login shell sets up.

enabled.description: Offer Codex workers (profiles with harness codex).

binary.description: Absolute path of the codex binary; defaults to a lookup on the PATH your login shell sets up.

enabled.description: Open and merge pull requests with the GitHub CLI (gh, logged in with `gh auth login`): ocd task pr / merge and the manager's PR tools. Off by default; when off, gh is never run. Restart to apply.

Use tmux: a notification click (ocd focus) switches to the manager's tmux pane and raises its terminal, and a taken-over session opens in its own tmux window when the TUI runs in tmux. Off by default; when off, tmux is never run.

allowFakeHarness.description: Allow profiles that use the fake harness (tests and dry runs).

intervalHours.description: Hours between automatic database backups; 0 disables them.

keep.description: Number of automatic backups to keep in ~/.ocd/backups.

branchSync.description: The branch-sync watchdog: keeps task branches near their repository's baseRef to reduce drift. Off by default.

mode.description: off: nothing runs. detect: read-only; tasks show how far their branch is behind the repo's baseRef and whether merging it would conflict. refresh: detect, and also fast-forward or merge the baseRef into clean, idle task branches at safe boundaries (never pushes, rebases, stashes or resolves conflicts). Per repo: repos.<name>.branchSync. See docs/branch-sync.md.

intervalMs.description: How often task branches are compared with their base (restart to apply).

maxTasksPerTick.description: At most this many tasks are checked per interval, least recently checked first.

manager.description: The manager: sessions in this directory act as manager, and the most recently used one receives updates.

directory.description: Working directory of the manager. OpenCode sessions started here may use the ocd_* tools; `~` is expanded.

repos.description: Repositories the manager may dispatch to. The key is the repository name. Saved changes apply automatically.

path.description: Repository root. `~` is expanded; symlinks are resolved.

profile.description: Default profile for tasks in this repository; must be declared under profiles.

baseRef.description: Ref new task branches start from. Defaults to the repository's current HEAD.

mergeMethod.description: How OCD merges this repository's pull requests when asked (default squash).

branchSync.description: Branch-sync mode for this repository's tasks, overriding branchSync.mode. Tracks baseRef, which must be set. See docs/branch-sync.md.

profiles.description: Named execution profiles. The key is the name used in dispatches and repo defaults. Saved changes apply automatically.

harness.description: Harness that runs the worker: opencode (sessions in the OpenCode service), claude (Claude Code CLI), codex (codex app-server), or fake (tests).

model.description: Model id. For OpenCode: provider/model, optionally #variant (see `opencode models`).

description.description: When to use this profile. Shown to the manager, which picks profiles by name.

agent.description: Harness agent preset, e.g. OpenCode's build agent.

instructions.description: Standing guidance added to every worker prompt using this profile.

permissionPolicy.description: ask: permission requests go to the human. deny: they are rejected and recorded. allow: each request is approved once, automatically, and recorded. yolo: the harness skips its permission checks and sandbox entirely (Claude Code --dangerously-skip-permissions, Codex approvalPolicy never + danger-full-access, OpenCode allow-all rule); nothing is asked or recorded.

envAllowlist.description: Environment variables passed to the worker in addition to a minimal base set (PATH, HOME, ...).
